title: Novo 2S Starter Kit – 2ml
description:
SMOK NOVO 2S POD KIT [CRC] is powered by 800mAh built-in battery with USB Type-C charging. The stealth LED indicator can clearly show you the battery level status whenever you need it. The auto-draw system starts the fresh puffs by inhaling directly through the mouthpiece. In addition, SMOK NOVO 2S POD KIT [CRC] is designed with several grooves around the body of the electrode to temporarily lock the condensate generated during vaping. It also comes with two SMOK NOVO 2 CLEAR REPLACEMENT PODS [CRC] (0.9ohm meshed Coil), which is perfect for MTL vapors to enjoy the purest vaping. With a side filling system and 1.8ml e-juice capacity, you are able to enjoy different flavors for a more fresh experience.

Parameters:

- Size 24.5*14.5*91.55mm

- Battery Capacity 800mAh built-in battery

- Charging Type-C charging

- Pod Capacity 1.8ml e-juice capacity

- Standby Current <20uA(No-load), <50uA(Load)

- Input Voltage 3.3V-4.2V

- Output Voltage 3.0V-3.5V

- Output Wattage 4W-20W

- Resistance Range 0.6ohm-2.5ohm

- Charging Current Max 0.5A

- Charging Voltage 5V±0.2V

- Overcharge Voltage 4.3V±0.05V

- Over-Discharge Voltage 2.4V±0.05V

- Overcharge Current 1A±0.6A

Features：

- Ultra-thin design, slight and portable

- The unique texture and anti-fingerprint design for an unexceptional look

- Ergonomics design for easy grip and comfortable single-handed operation

- Powered by a built-in 800mAh battery, durable in use

- Stealth LED Indicator, USB Type-C charging

- Auto Draw activated to bring fresh puffs

- Grooves for temporarily locking the condensate generated during vaping

- Bilateral U-shaped airflow channel, more air inflow, and smooth taste

- Two SMOK NOVO 2 CLEAR REPLACEMENT PODS MESHED 0.9OHM perfect for MTL vapors

- Structurally stable Meshed Coil for faster heating and better flavor

- 1.8ml e-juice capacity, side filling system

- Multiple Protections: Lithium Batter/Atomizer/8 Seconds Cut-off/Short Circuit/Low Voltage Protection

Includes:
1* SMOK NOVO 2S POD KIT [CRC]
2* SMOK NOVO 2 CLEAR REPLACEMENT PODS [CRC]-MESHED 0.9OHM
1* Type-C Cable
1* User Manual

Compatible Replacement Parts

- Novo Replacement Pods

- Novo 2 Pods

- Novo 2 Clear Pods
